entry.name: slide
entry.description: Filters an input value logarithmically between changes. It's particularly useful for envelope following and lowpass filtering to smooth a stream of continuous data.

arguments.name: slide-up
arguments.description: Specifies the slide up value. The default is 1.

arguments.name: slide-down-value
arguments.description: A second argument specifies the slide down value. The default is 1.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Performs the same function asusing the last input value.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: An input value to be filtered. When a new value is received, object filters an input value logarithmically between changes using the formulay (n) = y (n-1) + ((x (n) - y (n-1))/slide)A given sample output fromis equal to the last value plus the difference between the last value and the input divided by the slide value. Given a slide value of 1, the output will therefore always equal the input. Given a slide value of 10, the output will only change 1/10th as quickly as the input. This can be particularly useful for lowpass filtering or envelope following.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In middle inlet: Specifies the slide up value to be used when an incoming value is greater than the current value.

messages.name: ft2
messages.description: In right inlet: Specifies the slide down value to be used when an incoming value is less than the current value.

messages.name: reset
messages.description: Resets the current output sample to 0.

messages.name: set
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a number will set the current input value to the given number without causing output (can be used to cause successive output).
